summary: Separate the managed adopter pre-commit payload

delivery.outcome: The adopter pre-commit payload has a dedicated managed source, so its runtime can evolve independently from the standard hub's executing local hook.
nonGoals: Composing the worktree guard in this slice; that is the explicitly dependent follow-up
Removing or cleaning dirty historical worktrees
Publishing a standard release before the dependent composition ticket lands
Merging directly without exact-head trusted approval

architecture.decision: Copy the current lifecycle hook into a dedicated adopter template and point the managed package entry at it, leaving the hub's live hook untouched.
interfaceChanges: The managed adopter hook source is independent from the hub's live hook
architecture.rollback: Point the package entry back at .githooks/pre-commit and remove the dedicated template; adopter behavior remains unchanged in either form.

commands: set -e; for test in tests/*.test.sh; do bash $test; done
